description: Automatic territory assignment. First matching rule wins; evaluated on state, then zip prefix, then city. Owners are rep handles, not names. Round-robin pools split a territory evenly and deterministically by account id.
rules_notes: Partner-lane accounts always go to the partner owner regardless of geography.
A rule with an empty match is the catch-all and must be last.
Zip prefixes are checked before state so a specific territory beats the state fallback.
